Commentary.Commentary: That completes our formalities of this brilliant game. It was a rollicking contest and fair to say that the Windies were the deserving winners. Do-or-die time now for Pakistan with just two matches left in the series. The next game will be played on 9th April 2017 at this same venue. The action begins at 0930 local, 1330 GMT.  Do join us for that one. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says that the openers set up the chase really well and then Mohammed played a special innings with Nurse playing smartly in the end. Credits the batting coach and all the players who contributed to this victory. Reckons that such matches give them the confidence but series is far from over. Ends up by saying that they will have to play each and every match as a final as it all adds up to the World Cup qualification.

Man of the Match, Jason Mohammed says that it's nice to be playing for the West Indies again after making his debut in 2011. Says that they had the self belief to win the game and wanted to show their spirit to the world. Adds that it was difficult to score off the spinners and hence targeted the seamers. Reckons that his bat does the magic in clearing those fences.

Pakistan skipper, SARFRAZ AHMED says that it was a difficult match but they should have won it. Applauds Jason Mohammed's effort. Says that they lost the match in the last 10 overs as they crumbled under pressure. Ends up by saying that they will look to learn from their mistakes and make the corrections in the future matches.

Pakistan will be hurting big time. To be honest, they just wilted under the pressure towards the end. Hafeez and Malik were tidy with the ball but the wickets never really came at regular intervals and that cost the tourists. Amir and Shadab did keep them in the hunt but eventually, Jason Mohammed's encore proved too much for Pakistan. The visitors were clueless against some brutal powerhitting from West Indies. They will have to do some thinking on where things went wrong. Earlier on, they batted well as a unit to post 308 which unfortunately proved inadequate. A big reality check for Pakistan!

What a run chase! History created by the West Indies as this is the first time they have chased a target in excess of 300 in ODIs. Lewis and Powell had set a platform for them but the pace of scoring was on the slower side before that man, Jason Mohammed, entered the scene. He was positive from the outset and his stand with Carter turned the tide a bit. Although the latter departed, Mohammed wasn't to be denied as he just tore into the Pakistani bowling. Nurse blitzed a cameo himself as the duo sealed the chase with an over to spare.

THAT WILL DO! What an effort from the hosts! They didn't appear to stand a chance against the target but have managed to achieve the improbable. The Windies players have barged into the ground and the celebrations have begun. Coming to the ball, it's full outside off, Nurse drives it through point. There's a huge gap there and two runs are taken with ease. With that West Indies register an absolutely stunning victory. THEY WIN BY 4 WICKETS TO GO 1-0 UP in the 3-match ODI series.
Length delivery outside off, glided to third man for a single.
On the pads, flicked through square leg. Mohammed calls for the second and completes it. Good running that. What an innings has this guy played!
Very full outside off, jammed in the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Full delivery in the line of the stumps, Nurse clears his front leg and smokes it over mid-wicket. Finds the gap once again and the ball races to the fence. JUST 6 RUNS NEEDED TO WIN NOW!

IN THE AIR... BUT SAFE! Full on middle, Mohammed covers his stumps, then clears his front leg. Goes through with his heave. Gets a top edge and the ball lobs in between Riaz and the fielder coming in from mid-wicket. A single is taken. Mohammed breathes a sigh of relief.
WAHAB RIAZ is back.

FOUR! Amir tries the yorker, ends up bowling a low full toss on middle, Nurse whips it in front of square on the leg side. Finds the gap and the ball races to the fence. West Indies now just require 11 runs off 12 balls. For the first time, they need less than run-a-ball.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Very full on middle and leg, dug out on the leg side for a single.
Full toss on the pads, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Amir fires it very full around leg, Nurse looks to jam it out but fails. The ball goes off the pads on the leg side. There's a huge appeal for lbw but it's turned down. Pakistan use their review. After taking his time, the third umpire decides there's no edge involved. The Ball Tracker shows that the ball pitched outside leg and that saves the big man. A leg bye is taken.
Pakistan have taken a review for lbw against Nurse. Seemed a desperate one to be honest.

FOUR! Poor delivery to start the over. Bowls a back of a length delivery down the leg side, Nurse just helps it on its way very fine. Beats the man in deep and that's another boundary to Nurse. Amir too succumbing under pressure!
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back. Pressure totally on Pakistan now. Can Amir change things?
Low full toss, driven to long on for a single.
SIX! Tossed up outside off, Nurse kneels down, slog sweeps it against the spin over square leg for a maximum. That's sheer power.
Finally Mohammed manages to get bat on the ball. Cuts it through front of square on the off side for a single.
Served outside off, spinning away, Mohammed looks to glide it but misses again. Back-to-back dots!
Leg spinner outside off, Mohammed looks to cut it but misses it. 'Well bowled' says the skipper.
Shortish delivery, spinning away, punched through covers for a single.
On a length outside off, dabbed to point. Mohammed calls for a quick single and completes it. Good running that. 15 runs off the over. 32 needed of 24 balls now!
Fuller length delivery outside off, angling in, defended down the track.
FOUR! What a shot, Nurse! Riaz comes from around the wicket, fires it full outside off, Nurse bends his knees and lofts it over extra cover for another boundary.
Slip comes in place.

FOUR! Edged and four! The runs have started to flow here! Full outside off, Nurse goes after it with a big booming drive. Gets an outside edge and the ball flies past a diving Sarfraz to the third man fence.
Full outside off, Mohammed once again goes after it but the bat turns in his hands. Ends up slicing it over backward point. The third man fielder covers it and a single is taken.
FOUR! Full outside off, angling away, Mohammed once again makes some room, clobbers it with the angle over covers. Finds the gap in the cover region and gets a boundary.
Wide! Sprays it full and wide outside off, Mohammed makes room but misses. The ball is way away from the stumps and the umpire signals it as a wide.
WAHAB RIAZ is back.
Spinning away from outside off, dabbed in the point region for another single.
Tossed up outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Outside off, spinning away, guided to short third man for a single.
ASHLEY NURSE is the new man in.

OUT! HOLDER HOLES OUT! Tossed up outside off, Holder goes for the big shot again, connects this time but doesn't get it off the middle. The ball sails over wide long off, where Azam runs a couple of steps to his left and takes the catch. That's poor from the Windies skipper. He should have shown maturity there! 50 needed off 33 balls!
Shadab tosses it outside off, Holder once again goes for the big shot but misses as the ball turns away.
SIX! Quicker one on off, Holder clears his front leg and tonks it straight over the bowler's head for half a dozen.

FOUR! Misfield and a boundary! Fuller on the pads, clipped through fine leg, Riaz at short fine leg gets an awkward bounce in front of him and fumbles. The ball races to the fence. 17 runs off the over! 56 runs needed of 36 balls now!
SIX! Take that, Amir! Fuller one outside leg, Mohammed clears his front leg and smokes it over mid-wicket. The ball just sails into the stands. Mohammed has turned this match upside down.
Amir goes back to his go-to ball, bowls a yorker on off, Mohammed does well to keep it out.
SIX! OUT OF HERE! Amir goes short again, but this time it's Mohammed on strike. He makes room, clears his front leg and smashes it over wide long on for a big maximum.
Back of a length delivery, Holder pulls it but doesn't connect it cleanly. Goes on the bounce to deep mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Fuller length delivery outside leg, angling away, Holder turns it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Mohammed goes for a big booming drive. But the ball turns away sharply beating him in his drive.
Outside off, spinning away, punched through covers for a couple.
Leg spinner on middle, Mohammed looks to work it on the leg side but gets surprised by the turn and bounce. Does well to adjust and tap it back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Holder reaches for it and drives it through covers for a single.
Short outside off, spinning away, cut through point for a single.
Leg spinner outside off, chopped behind square on the off side.
SHADAB KHAN is back on.
On the pads, worked to the left of short fine leg for a single.
Tries the yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss, driven straight down the ground towards long off for a single.
Fuller one the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
JASON HOLDER walks out to bat.

OUT! AMIR STRIKES! Full and quick outside off, Carter goes through with his drive. Goes hard at it but gets a thick outside edge and the ball carries all the way to Riaz at short third man, who fumbles a touch but holds onto it in his second attempt. Carter departs. Can this break the hosts' momentum?
Yorker outside off, Carter fails to dig it out. That's the go-to ball!
Length delivery, angling away, Mohammed goes hard at it. Gets a thickish outside edge and the ball goes in a flash towards Kamran at short third man. A single is taken.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back on.
Short delivery, Jason rides the bounce and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, played to point with soft hands for a quick single. There's a shy at the striker's end but it misses. However, Mohammed had did really well to get in with a dive.
Angling away from Mohammed, he dabs it behind point for a single.
FOUR! SLASHED AWAY! Short and angling away, Mohammed clears his front leg and slashes it over backward point for a boundary.
Well-directed bouncer, lands it around leg, gets it to angle away from the batsman, who does well to lean back and gets out of harm's way in time.
3rd ODI fifty for Jason Mohammed!

FOUR! Back of a length delivery on leg, Mohammed goes up on one leg and drags it behind square on the leg side. The player in the deep tries his best to reach the ball but fails. Mohammed gets to his fifty with this. What a knock it has been. He has brought this match to life.
WAHAB RIAZ is back on. West Indies need 93 off 60 balls to win.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Five fielders allowed outside the ring.
Fuller on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! THERE HE GOES AGAIN! Cutter outside off, width on offer and Mohammed once again picks it very early. Rises on his toes and absolutely butchers this to the right of the sweeper cover fielder for a boundary. Picked his spot well and fetched the rewards. Is this the over that tilts the balance towards WI? Well the hosts certainly are now truly alive in this.
50-run stand between Mohammed and Carter.

SIX! KABOOM! What a shot! Mid off had dropped back after the previous shot and so Mohammed decides to clear the ropes to make a statement. Picked the slower ball early and smashed it deep into the stands at long off. Mammoth blow! Pakistan suddenly facing the heat.

FOUR! Mohammed continues to motor along! Back of a length outside off, he makes a bit of room and flays this easily over wide mid off. Safe shot with nobody in the deep and it's another boundary. This is turning to be a gem from the young man.
Length ball outside off, makes room and cuts it towards point where Shadab is quick to swoop in on the ball. Carter wanted the single and is forced to return. Puts in a desperate dive.
Back of a length outside off, punched uppishly towards cover. Just on the bounce to the fielder.
Floated around middle, steps out and whips it towards long on. On the bounce to the fielder. Single taken.
Fired in around middle, pushed it towards mid on.
Mid-wicket comes in, sweeper cover in place.

FOUR! SHOT! He was in total control this time! Quicker and short outside off, allows Mohammed to free his arms and he nails the cut through point. Successive boundaries and momentum in the chase for the Windies. 200 up for WI. 109 needed from 68 balls. This stand is turning it on.
FOUR! Sliced away! Flatter outside off, Mohammed flashes at it and gets it off the outer half. Beats Hasan Ali at short third man and the ball races away to the fence.
Quicker ball around leg stump, flicked through backward square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven firmly towards mid off.
IMAD WASIM is back.
Short of a length around leg stump, worked through mid-wicket with soft hands. Good running gives them a brace but they were helped by a very wayward throw at the keeper's end.
Fuller ball on the sticks, pushed down to long on for a single.

FOUR! BANG! Oh this lad, Mohammed! Makes batting look so easy at times. Fuller ball around middle, he holds his poise and clears his front leg to loft it dead straight down the ground. One bounce and over the ropes for a boundary.
Good length around middle, worked to the left of mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, squirted down to third man for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mohammed mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
HASAN ALI is back.
On middle and leg, Mohammed tickles it down to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! SMACK! What a shot that is! Made a cracking sound off the bat. Length ball outside off, Mohammed crunches it over cover with a meaty blow to find the fence. That almost came out of the blue. Much-needed boundary for WI.
Slower ball outside off, pushed towards mid off for a single.
Shortish and angled in around off, tapped towards point for a single.
Back of a length outside off, stabbed towards point off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, glided down to third man for a single.
Flatter on middle, gets back and mistimes the pull to the leg side.
Drifting in from around off, drilled square of the wicket on the off side for a brace.
Floated around leg stump, a bit short and worked away to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Floated around leg stump, Carter looks to sweep but gets it off the bottom part to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, leans across and pushes it towards cover.
Floated around leg stump, Carter looks to play the reverse sweep and gets a faint edge on to the pads.
Shortish around off, pushed off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
That was close! Back of a length outside off, comes back in sharply as Mohammed looks to cut. A hint of reverse there perhaps as the ball goes past the inside edge.

FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! Mohammed uses the pace of Wahab Riaz to perfection here. Short of a length outside off, plays it very late and opens the bat face smartly. Gets it well to the left of the third man fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! EDGED BUT SAFE! Back of a length outside off, Carter flashes at it but gets a thickish edge that just eludes a diving Sarfraz. The ball goes away fine towards the third man fence. Frustration for the Pakistanis but Ahmed had no chance of taking that one.
Back of a length around off, worked off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
Floated outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Drifting in around off, worked with the turn to long on for a single.
JONATHAN CARTER walks out to bat.
Drinks break....

OUT! SHADAB STRIKES! His first ODI scalp and he is elated. Cracking delivery to start with and sharp work from Sarfraz too. Lovely leg break outside off, Hope reaches out to work it on the leg side but is undone by the turn and bounce. In the process, he also comes out of the crease and Sarfraz does well to whip off the bails in a flash after collecting the ball smartly. It wasn't an easy take due to the bounce but the Pakistani skipper made it look easy. WI need 151 from 98 balls.
Stumping appeal has been referred upstairs. Hope seems to be a goner here. Excellent work from Sarfraz.
Drifting in around middle, worked gently towards mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, spinning away, Hope gets a bottom edge on to the pitch.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards mid off.
SHADAB KHAN is back.
Shortish outside off, Mohammed steers it straight to the fielder at point.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends well.
Good length angling across the right-hander, left alone to the keeper.
Back of a length around middle, raps Hope high on the pads as the batsmen take a leg bye.
Shortish around middle, helped down to fine leg for a single.
JASON MOHAMMED is the new man in.

OUT! BRILLIANT FROM WAHAB! Starts the new spell with a slower ball outside off and deceives Powell who is expecting a pacy ball. He is early into the drive and spoons a simple catch to Akmal at mid off. It's Kamran's first ODI catch as a fielder. Timely strike for Pakistan as this 65-run partnership was gaining momentum. Decent knock from Powell comes to an end.
WAHAB RIAZ is back.
Dug in short around leg stump, Hope ducks under it. Looked like a wide due to the line but not given by the umpire.
Back of a length around off, swivels a bit and flogs this to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish around off, stays back to that one and pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good length around middle, nudged off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Fires in a fine yorker around middle, Powell squeezes it out towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around off, leans across and drives it to long on for a single.
Quicker ball around off, Powell makes room and cuts it uppishly to deep backward point. Once bounce to the fielder for a single.
Angled in around middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Darted in outside off, muscles the pull down the ground to long on for a run.

FOUR! AERIAL BUT IN THE GAP! Fired in around middle, Powell makes room and slashes it with all his might. Goes off the slice again and this time over point to the fence. He is now batting more fluently after the initial struggle.
Flatter around middle, Powell looks to punch it on the off side but gets it off the slice to point.
Length delivery outside off, glided to third man for a single. WEST INDIES NEED 165 OFF 120 BALLS!
Length delivery, angling in, punched back to the bowler. Amir tries to deflect it onto the stumps at the bowler's end but misses. Had that hit, Hope could have been in big trouble.
8th ODI fifty for Powell.
FOUR! This time Powell connects and connects it well. It's short outside off, angling in, pulled hard over mid-wicket for a boundary. This brings up the 50-run stand between Powell and Hope!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Powell goes through with his pull shot but ends up swinging at the air.
Shortish on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery, defended from within the crease by Hope.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is back!

ANOTHER SHOUT FOR LBW TURNED DOWN! Tossed up outside off, Powell kneels down to sweep but misses. Gets hit on the pads and there is a huge appeal for lbw but it's turned down. Impact maybe outside off.
Flatter delivery, skidding away from leg, turned to mid-wicket.
Sliding down leg, worked down the leg side for a single.
Drifts this one quicker through the air, defended back to the bowler.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
THAT MISSED EVERYTHING! A straighter one on middle, skids through, Powell looks to play across the line but gets beaten. The ball then whizzes just past the off pole. Powell survives.
IMAD WASIM comes on to bowl.
Sliding towards the pads, Hope nudges it fine down the leg side. There's a short fine leg present and no runs are conceded.
SIX! Full outside off, Hope gives himself some room and launches this over extra cover for a maximum. That is some hit!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller on the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Pitched outside off, punched to covers.
Five Wides! Darts this one down the leg side, Powell misses his flick and Sarfraz fails to collect it. The ball races down to the fence behind. Wide is signalled.
Arm ball, sliding into the southpaw, punched to covers.
FOUR! Tossed up outside off, Hope kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Good over for WI!
Shortish delivery, punched off the back foot to deep covers for a single.

Huge shout for lbw! Tossed up outside off, spinning in, Powell goes for the reverse sweep but misses. The ball hits him on the box and there's a huge appeal for lbw which is turned down. The Hawk Eye shows that ball was turning too much and going on to miss the stumps.
Short delivery, pulled on the leg side for a single.
In the air... but safe! Powell gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it over wide mid on for a brace.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Shortish delivery, punched to the right of Malik, who tries to cut it but fails. However the extra cover fielder covers it and prevents the single.
Two Leg Byes! Powell goes for the lap-sweep but misses. The ball brushes his pads, goes above the stumps. Sarfraz fails to collect it and the ball takes a couple of leg byes.

FOUR! Powell steps down the track, Malik spots that and bowls it short outside off, Powell still goes after it. Lofts it over wide mid off. Shehzad in the deep, runs to his right and dives to take the catch. However, he misjudges it slightly and the ball bounces beside his hand and crosses the ropes for a boundary.
Tossed up on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Slides this into the batsman, defended with the angle to mid-wicket.
Fuller one on the pads, worked to backward square leg.
SHOAIB MALIK is back.
Short and wide outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Slider, keeps a touch low, Hopes mistimes his punch to covers.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up around middle, driven back to the bowler.

FOUR! Powell give charge this time, Shadab bowls it quickly, ends up bowling a full toss. Powell a gets an outside edge and the ball races through Sarfraz's legs to the fence behind. West Indies won't mind how the runs come.
Powell makes room, Shadab slips it wide outside off. Powell drives it on the full to covers. Missed out on that one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning into the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Full and sliding into Powell, he clips it through mid-wicket. Completes the single and takes off for the second. But seeing Azam get to the ball quickly, Hope sends his partner back.
Fuller one around off, driven past Hafeez for a single.
Sliding into the pads, punched to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Powell dances down the track, Hafeez sees that and darts it fuller on the pads, cramping him for room. Powell fails to dig it out and gets hit on the pads.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, driven off the front foot through the gap in covers for a couple.
Googly around off, turned to mid-wicket with the spin.
Tossed up on middle and leg, spinning in, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Powell dances down the track, drives it through cover-point for a couple.
Full outside off, spinning away, driven through covers for a single.
Served flatter outside off, spinning in, punched to long on for a single.
Spinning in from outside off, turned in front of square on the leg side for a single.
SHAI HOPE is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Hafeez has the last laugh. Great comeback from him after getting hit for a maximum. Bowls this flatter outside off, skidding in, Lewis goes back to cut but misses it completely. The ball goes past the bat and clips the off stump. That's end of Lewis' decent knock. Pakistan well on top. They need 8 more wickets to win while WI need 216 runs off 170 balls.

SIX! That will release some pressure! First boundary after the 10th over. Full delivery around middle and off, Lewis gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a huge maximum. A much-needed one.
Powell dances down the track, drives the full ball to long off for a single.
Flatter one around off, spinning away, punched to long off for a single.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Full outside off, Powell kneels down to sweep but gets an inside edge to short fine leg.
Served around leg, spinning down leg, Powell misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Fuller on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, whipped through square leg. A brace is taken and Sarfraz is not happy with his fielder there.
On middle and leg, spinning in, turned to mid-wicket.
SHADAB KHAN comes on to bowl now.
Fuller around middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, gets back and dabs it towards cover for a single.
Flatter and full around middle, nudged towards wide long on. Single taken. The batsmen wanted the second but Shadab Khan was quick to pounce on the ball.
Full and on the stumps, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Floated around leg stump, gets across and sweeps it to deep backward square leg. A couple taken as Amir tidies up near the fence.
Flatter outside off, gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Superb wide yorker outside off, nothing much Lewis can do about it as he fails to dig it out.
Free Hit coming up...
Another short ball around off, Lewis sways away from the line of it. No ball given as Riaz has exceeded the limit of bouncers for the over. He isn't happy with the call but that's how it is.
The umpire has given a friendly caution to Wahab for running close to the danger area of the track.
Another bouncer and Lewis ducks under it once more.
Short ball around middle, Lewis ducks under the bumper.
On middle and leg, clipped down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, pushed through point for a brace.
Shortish and around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and taps it to the off side.
Fired in around off, punched off the back foot towards extra cover.
Flatter around off, Lewis misses the sweep and is hit on the pads. Stifled lbw appeal but probably missing leg.
Flatter outside off, gets back and blocks it towards cover.
Drifting in around middle, pushed back down the track as Hafeez gets a hand on it. Parries it towards mid-wicket. Single taken.
Flighted outside off, low full toss and Powell bunts it back to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, stylish back foot punch to sweeper cover. Just a run.
Wahab hits the deck hard and the ball goes off the splice of the bat as Powell looks to push off the back foot. The ball dribbles to backward point.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and jabs it to third man for a single.
Shortish around middle, Lewis ducks under the bumper.
Shortish around middle, rises on his toes to fend it on to the track.
Back of a length outside off, Lewis gets back and pats it towards cover.
WAHAB RIAZ has a change of ends.
Drinks break....
Fired in around leg stump, Powell misses the flick and is struck on the pads.
Speared down the leg side, that shall be a wide.
Fired in around off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Floated outside off, Lewis gets a faint inside edge on to the pads.

Optimistic appeal for caught behind! Fired down the leg side, Lewis misses the flick and there is a noise as the ball goes through to Sarfraz. Probably brushed the pad on its way as the umpire rejects the appeal.
Flatter outside off, gets back and pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Speared in around leg stump, gets back to flick but is struck on the pads. Muted appeal for lbw but that was missing leg.
Fired in around middle, worked towards mid-wicket. Single taken.
Quicker and a bit short outside off, Powell cuts it towards point but cannot find the gap. He is struggling big time here.
Quicker ball outside off, sits back and powers it to long off for a run.
Fuller and outside off, drilled down to long off for a single.
Fired in around middle, Powell stays back and pats it back to the bowler.
Flatter around middle, gets back and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Flatter and outside off, Powell rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Fullish around middle, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good running! It's not been a common feature for WI but this is nicely done. Flatter around leg stump, chipped uppishly through mid-wicket and they hare back for the second run.
Drifting in from around off, Powell charges down the track to whip across the line but gets a leading edge down the ground. Single to long off.
Speared in around middle, tucked to the right of the square leg fielder for a single.
Quicker and outside off, Lewis hangs back and punches it to mid off.
Flatter on a length outside off, gets back and punches it to long off for a single.
Floated outside off, pushed gently to the right of the cover fielder. Single was there for the taking but the laziness of the Windies batsmen coming to the fore again.
Fires it around leg stump, Powell misses the sweep and the ball goes to short fine leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Loopy and outside off, steps out and blocks it towards the bowler.
Floated around off, pushed gently towards mid on.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks towards cover.
A bit short outside off, Lewis gets back and cuts it towards cover.
Flighted on off, driven down to long on for a single.
Loopy around middle, Lewis drills it down to long on for a single.
Flatter outside off, gets back and punches it to cover.
Floated outside off, Powell leans across to flick but gets a leading edge to the off side. Single taken.
Floated outside off, gets back and pushes it towards cover.
Tossed up fuller around off, driven firmly back to the bowler.
Quicker ball around off, Lewis blocks it solidly from the crease to short cover.
Tossed up wider outside off, driven firmly to long off for a single.
Loopy and wider outside off, Powell goes for the wild sweep but misses.
Drifting in from outside off, Powell stays back and pushes it to cover.
Floated outside off, gets back and blocks it to the off side.
Length delivery outside off, defended from within the crease on the off side.
Short delivery, angling in, Lewis gets on his toes and jabs it into the deck.
Banged in short outside off, Lewis lets it sail through.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Lewis makes full use of the width on offer as he slaps it through cover-point for a boundary.
Banged in short, angling in, EL ducks under it.
Wide! Back-to-back wides. Unecessary extras from Pakistan. Once again it's going down the leg side.
Wide! Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, Lewis leaves it. A wide is signalled.
Fuller on the boots, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
WAHAB RIAZ is on now!
Drifts it on the pads, worked off the front foot straight to short fine leg.
Full on middle and off, driven to long off for a single.
Full outside off, Lewis lets it go through to the keeper.
Powell gets to the pitch of the ball and places it in the cover region for a single.
Served outside off, the ball takes off a touch extra after pitching. Powell looks to sway at it but misses.
Full outside off, driven straight back.
SHOAIB MALIK is into the attack. Spin from both ends!
Full and in the line of the stumps, swept behind square on the leg side, where the short fine leg fielder makes a great save.
Full outside off, eased to long off for a single.
Slips one down the leg side, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one outside off, punched to covers.
Full outside off, Lewis strides forward to drive but mistimes it to long on for a single.
Floated on middle, eased to long on for a single.
MOHAMMAD HAFEEZ comes on to bowl.
Fuller length delivery outside off, punched to cover-point.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! On a length outside off, Powell punches it hard through covers for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, punched on the up to covers.
Pitched on a length outside off, defended on the off side.
Leg bye! Full and angling down leg, Lewis misses his flick. The ball brushes his pad and goes towards short fine leg, who fumbles a touch and allows the batsmen to cross for a leg bye.
Angling into the batsman, played to wide of mid on for a single.
Ali comes from around the wicket, pitches it full around off, driven to mid on. Sarfraz advises Ali not to pitch the ball up.
SIX! A superb pick up shot! Fuller on middle, Lewis just flicks it effortlessly. Clears the mid-wicket fence with ease. This shot was all about timing.
Full outside off, driven crisply to covers.
Fuller length delivery, angling away, punched on the up but it's straight to covers.
Length delivery outside leg, Lewis looks to tuck it but the extra bounce takes him by surprise. Gets it off the gloves onto his helmet.
Fullish outside off, driven to mid off.
On the pads, played with the angle to mid-wicket.
Peach of a delivery! On a length outside off, straightens a touch after pitching. Powell feels for it but gets beaten on his outside edge.
KIERAN POWELL walks in at 3!

OUT! SOFT DISMISSAL! Length delivery outside off, Walton looks to go after Amir, covers his stumps and tries to loft it over mid off but fails to get any elevation and distance on it. Mistimes it straight into the hands of Wahab Riaz at mid off, who makes no mistake. Amir gets his man and Pakistan are elated. Another failure for Walton.
On a good length outside off, angling in a touch, Walton looks to flick it by getting across but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller on the boots, tickled to fine leg for a single.
Wide! Amir is not able to find his rhythm. Spills it down the leg side again. Lewis tries flicking it but misses. Another wide by Amir!
On the pads, played in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Fuller length delivery around leg, angling away, Lewis looks to defend it from within the crease but gets an outside edge. The ball goes towards Sarfraz, who takes it by diving ahead to his left. He is confident and starts appealing. The umpires aren't sure and send the decision upstairs. The replays confirm the outside edge but shows that the ball falls just in front of Sarfraz's gloves. Lewis survives!
There's an appeal for caught behind against Lewis. Sarfraz thinks he has caught it cleanly but the umpires are not sure and wants to check it upstairs.
Full outside off, Walton covers his stumps, tries to guide it on the off side. Gets it off the outer half past backward point for a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched back to the bowler.
On a length outside off, angling in, tapped back to the bowler.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Length delivery, defended solidly.
Wide! Third one of the over! This time fires it down the leg side of Lewis, who initially thinks of playing but then leaves it.
Full outside off, driven straight down the ground. Riaz at mid off, runs to his right and cuts it. Concedes just a single.
Wide outside off, angling away, left alone.

LBW SHOUT! Pitched outside leg, angling towards the stumps, Walton looks to tuck it but misses. Gets hit high on the pads and the ball lobs straight to Shehzad at point. Amir appeals for lbw but it's turned down. Amir asks his skipper to go for the review but he doesn't agree with his bowler. The replays confirm it pitching outside leg.
Length delivery around off, angling away, defended in the cover region.
Wide! Another delivery going down leg, Chadwick misses his flick again and the umpire spreads his arms to signal a wide.

Full outside off, angling towards the bat, Walton tries to flick it but is early to close the face of his bat. Gets a leading edge towards mid off. It was in the air for some time but fell in no man's land.
Wide! Back of a length delivery down the leg side, Walton looks to pull it but misses. A wide is signaled!
Good length delivery on leg, defended to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Length delivery, angling away, Lewis punches it through covers for another boundary. Superb shot that!
FOUR! IN THE GAP! Again it's full outside off with no swing whatsoever. Lewis just drives it uppishly off the front foot. Gets it past Malik at mid off this time and finds the fence behind.
Straight and full around off, pushed to wide of mid off for a single.

Full outside off, Lewis times his drive nicely. Gets it to the right of Malik at mid off, who runs across and cuts it with a slide. Superb stroke and an equally good fielding effort. A single is taken.
Good length delivery, angling away, punched to covers.
HASAN ALI to bowl with the other new ball.
FOUR! GLORIOUS SHOT! Full outside off, Walton drives it crisply through covers and the ball races to the fence like a tracer bullet.
On the pads, turned to mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle and leg, driven nicely straight back. Amir does really well to get low and stop it in his followthrough.
Wide outside off, angling away, left alone.
Nice shape on that ball and well played too. Fuller on middle, shaping away late, clipped to fine leg. Lewis gets off the mark with a single.
Full outside off, swinging away, pushed to cover-point.
Welcome back for the run chase. EVIN LEWIS and CHADWICK WALTON to open the batting. MOHAMMAD AMIR with the ball in his hands. He has two slips in place. Here we go...
